column1: Type: accident / near miss / illness / violence or aggression / property damage
Describe what happened, in order, factually
What activity was being carried out at the time
Were the correct guards, signage or protective equipment in use? (Y/N)
Injury sustained and to which part of the body
First aid given, by whom, at what time
Sent home / continued shift / taken to hospital / ambulance called
Did the person lose any time off work? (days)
What was done to make the area safe
Time the area was made safe
Was equipment taken out of use? (Y/N — asset or serial number)
Root cause as far as it can be established
Corrective action to prevent a repeat
Who is responsible for it and by what date
Reportable to an external authority? (Y/N — reference)
Complete this on the day of the incident. Record facts and times, not opinions about fault.
Log near misses too — they are the warnings that cost you nothing.
Reporting duties for serious incidents and record retention periods vary by country. Check your own local requirements.
